# Catalog

3919 live Grok Bot templates converted to Pi packages (3913 full recipe, 6 metadata-only). 32 share links that no longer resolve are listed at the end. Machine-readable version: [catalog.json](catalog.json).

Columns: **S/R/M/C** = skills / routines / memory seeds / connectors. **Fidelity**: `full` = complete recipe from the template's import API; `metadata-only` = only the public name and description were available.
